005package org.wpilib.drive;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.util.function.DoubleConsumer;
010import org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorController;
011import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
012import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Translation2d;
013import org.wpilib.math.util.MathUtil;
014import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
015import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
016import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
017
018/**
019 * A class for driving Mecanum drive platforms.
020 *
021 * <p>Mecanum drives are rectangular with one wheel on each corner. Each wheel has rollers toed in
022 * 45 degrees toward the front or back. When looking at the wheels from the top, the roller axles
023 * should form an X across the robot. Each drive() function provides different inverse kinematic
024 * relations for a Mecanum drive robot.
025 *
026 * <p>Drive base diagram:
027 *
028 * <pre>
029 * \\_______/
030 * \\ |   | /
031 *   |   |
032 * /_|___|_\\
033 * /       \\
034 * </pre>
035 *
036 * <p>Each drive() function provides different inverse kinematic relations for a Mecanum drive
037 * robot.
038 *
039 * <p>This library uses the NWU axes convention (North-West-Up as external reference in the world
040 * frame). The positive X axis points ahead, the positive Y axis points to the left, and the
041 * positive Z axis points up. Rotations follow the right-hand rule, so counterclockwise rotation
042 * around the Z axis is positive.
043 *
044 * <p>Inputs smaller then {@value org.wpilib.drive.RobotDriveBase#DEFAULT_DEADBAND} will be set to
045 * 0, and larger values will be scaled so that the full range is still used. This deadband value can
046 * be changed with {@link #setDeadband}.
047 *
048 * <p>{@link org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorSafety} is enabled by default. The driveCartesian or
049 * drivePolar methods should be called periodically to avoid Motor Safety timeouts.
050 */
051public class MecanumDrive extends RobotDriveBase implements TelemetryLoggable {
052  private final DoubleConsumer m_frontLeftMotor;
053  private final DoubleConsumer m_rearLeftMotor;
054  private final DoubleConsumer m_frontRightMotor;
055  private final DoubleConsumer m_rearRightMotor;
056
057  // Used for telemetry
058  private double m_frontLeftOutput;
059  private double m_rearLeftOutput;
060  private double m_frontRightOutput;
061  private double m_rearRightOutput;
062
063  private boolean m_reported;
064
065  /**
066   * Wheel velocities for a mecanum drive.
067   *
068   * <p>Uses normalized voltage [-1.0..1.0].
069   */
070  public static class WheelVelocities {
071    /** Front-left wheel velocity. */
072    public double frontLeft;
073
074    /** Front-right wheel velocity. */
075    public double frontRight;
076
077    /** Rear-left wheel velocity. */
078    public double rearLeft;
079
080    /** Rear-right wheel velocity. */
081    public double rearRight;
082
083    /** Constructs a WheelVelocities with zeroes for all four velocities. */
084    public WheelVelocities() {}
085
086    /**
087     * Constructs a WheelVelocities.
088     *
089     * @param frontLeft The front left velocity [-1.0..1.0].
090     * @param frontRight The front right velocity [-1.0..1.0].
091     * @param rearLeft The rear left velocity [-1.0..1.0].
092     * @param rearRight The rear right velocity [-1.0..1.0].
093     */
094    public WheelVelocities(double frontLeft, double frontRight, double rearLeft, double rearRight) {
095      this.frontLeft = frontLeft;
096      this.frontRight = frontRight;
097      this.rearLeft = rearLeft;
098      this.rearRight = rearRight;
099    }
100  }
101
102  /**
103   * Construct a MecanumDrive.
104   *
105   * <p>If a motor needs to be inverted, do so before passing it in.
106   *
107   * @param frontLeftMotor The motor on the front-left corner.
108   * @param rearLeftMotor The motor on the rear-left corner.
109   * @param frontRightMotor The motor on the front-right corner.
110   * @param rearRightMotor The motor on the rear-right corner.
111   */
112  public MecanumDrive(
113      MotorController frontLeftMotor,
114      MotorController rearLeftMotor,
115      MotorController frontRightMotor,
116      MotorController rearRightMotor) {
117    this(
118        (double output) -> frontLeftMotor.setThrottle(output),
119        (double output) -> rearLeftMotor.setThrottle(output),
120        (double output) -> frontRightMotor.setThrottle(output),
121        (double output) -> rearRightMotor.setThrottle(output));
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Construct a MecanumDrive.
126   *
127   * <p>If a motor needs to be inverted, do so before passing it in.
128   *
129   * @param frontLeftMotor The setter for the motor on the front-left corner.
130   * @param rearLeftMotor The setter for the motor on the rear-left corner.
131   * @param frontRightMotor The setter for the motor on the front-right corner.
132   * @param rearRightMotor The setter for the motor on the rear-right corner.
133   */
134  public MecanumDrive(
135      DoubleConsumer frontLeftMotor,
136      DoubleConsumer rearLeftMotor,
137      DoubleConsumer frontRightMotor,
138      DoubleConsumer rearRightMotor) {
139    requireNonNullParam(frontLeftMotor, "frontLeftMotor", "MecanumDrive");
140    requireNonNullParam(rearLeftMotor, "rearLeftMotor", "MecanumDrive");
141    requireNonNullParam(frontRightMotor, "frontRightMotor", "MecanumDrive");
142    requireNonNullParam(rearRightMotor, "rearRightMotor", "MecanumDrive");
143
144    m_frontLeftMotor = frontLeftMotor;
145    m_rearLeftMotor = rearLeftMotor;
146    m_frontRightMotor = frontRightMotor;
147    m_rearRightMotor = rearRightMotor;
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * Drive method for Mecanum platform.
152   *
153   * <p>Angles are measured counterclockwise from the positive X axis. The robot's velocity is
154   * independent of its angle or rotation rate.
155   *
156   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
157   * @param yVelocity The robot's velocity along the Y axis [-1.0..1.0]. Left is positive.
158   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
159   *     positive.
160   */
161  public void driveCartesian(double xVelocity, double yVelocity, double zRotation) {
162    driveCartesian(xVelocity, yVelocity, zRotation, Rotation2d.ZERO);
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * Drive method for Mecanum platform.
167   *
168   * <p>Angles are measured counterclockwise from the positive X axis. The robot's velocity is
169   * independent of its angle or rotation rate.
170   *
171   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
172   * @param yVelocity The robot's velocity along the Y axis [-1.0..1.0]. Left is positive.
173   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
174   *     positive.
175   * @param gyroAngle The gyro heading around the Z axis. Use this to implement field-oriented
176   *     controls.
177   */
178  public void driveCartesian(
179      double xVelocity, double yVelocity, double zRotation, Rotation2d gyroAngle) {
180    if (!m_reported) {
181      UsageReporting.reportUsage("RobotDrive", "MecanumCartesian");
182      m_reported = true;
183    }
184
185    xVelocity = MathUtil.applyDeadband(xVelocity, m_deadband);
186    yVelocity = MathUtil.applyDeadband(yVelocity, m_deadband);
187
188    var velocities = driveCartesianIK(xVelocity, yVelocity, zRotation, gyroAngle);
189
190    m_frontLeftOutput = velocities.frontLeft * m_maxOutput;
191    m_rearLeftOutput = velocities.rearLeft * m_maxOutput;
192    m_frontRightOutput = velocities.frontRight * m_maxOutput;
193    m_rearRightOutput = velocities.rearRight * m_maxOutput;
194
195    m_frontLeftMotor.accept(m_frontLeftOutput);
196    m_frontRightMotor.accept(m_frontRightOutput);
197    m_rearLeftMotor.accept(m_rearLeftOutput);
198    m_rearRightMotor.accept(m_rearRightOutput);
199
200    feed();
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * Drive method for Mecanum platform.
205   *
206   * <p>Angles are measured counterclockwise from straight ahead. The velocity at which the robot
207   * drives (translation) is independent of its angle or rotation rate.
208   *
209   * @param magnitude The robot's velocity at a given angle [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
210   * @param angle The gyro heading around the Z axis at which the robot drives.
211   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
212   *     positive.
213   */
214  public void drivePolar(double magnitude, Rotation2d angle, double zRotation) {
215    if (!m_reported) {
216      UsageReporting.reportUsage("RobotDrive", "MecanumPolar");
217      m_reported = true;
218    }
219
220    driveCartesian(
221        magnitude * angle.getCos(), magnitude * angle.getSin(), zRotation, Rotation2d.ZERO);
222  }
223
224  /**
225   * Cartesian inverse kinematics for Mecanum platform.
226   *
227   * <p>Angles are measured counterclockwise from the positive X axis. The robot's velocity is
228   * independent of its angle or rotation rate.
229   *
230   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
231   * @param yVelocity The robot's velocity along the Y axis [-1.0..1.0]. Left is positive.
232   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
233   *     positive.
234   * @return Wheel velocities [-1.0..1.0].
235   */
236  public static WheelVelocities driveCartesianIK(
237      double xVelocity, double yVelocity, double zRotation) {
238    return driveCartesianIK(xVelocity, yVelocity, zRotation, Rotation2d.ZERO);
239  }
240
241  /**
242   * Cartesian inverse kinematics for Mecanum platform.
243   *
244   * <p>Angles are measured clockwise from the positive X axis. The robot's velocity is independent
245   * of its angle or rotation rate.
246   *
247   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
248   * @param yVelocity The robot's velocity along the Y axis [-1.0..1.0]. Left is positive.
249   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
250   *     positive.
251   * @param gyroAngle The gyro heading around the Z axis. Use this to implement field-oriented
252   *     controls.
253   * @return Wheel velocities [-1.0..1.0].
254   */
255  public static WheelVelocities driveCartesianIK(
256      double xVelocity, double yVelocity, double zRotation, Rotation2d gyroAngle) {
257    xVelocity = Math.clamp(xVelocity, -1.0, 1.0);
258    yVelocity = Math.clamp(yVelocity, -1.0, 1.0);
259
260    // Compensate for gyro angle.
261    var input = new Translation2d(xVelocity, yVelocity).rotateBy(gyroAngle.unaryMinus());
262
263    double[] wheelVelocities = new double[4];
264    wheelVelocities[MotorType.FRONT_LEFT.value] = input.getX() + input.getY() + zRotation;
265    wheelVelocities[MotorType.FRONT_RIGHT.value] = input.getX() - input.getY() - zRotation;
266    wheelVelocities[MotorType.REAR_LEFT.value] = input.getX() - input.getY() + zRotation;
267    wheelVelocities[MotorType.REAR_RIGHT.value] = input.getX() + input.getY() - zRotation;
268
269    normalize(wheelVelocities);
270
271    return new WheelVelocities(
272        wheelVelocities[MotorType.FRONT_LEFT.value],
273        wheelVelocities[MotorType.FRONT_RIGHT.value],
274        wheelVelocities[MotorType.REAR_LEFT.value],
275        wheelVelocities[MotorType.REAR_RIGHT.value]);
276  }
277
278  @Override
279  public void stopMotor() {
280    m_frontLeftOutput = 0.0;
281    m_frontRightOutput = 0.0;
282    m_rearLeftOutput = 0.0;
283    m_rearRightOutput = 0.0;
284
285    m_frontLeftMotor.accept(0.0);
286    m_frontRightMotor.accept(0.0);
287    m_rearLeftMotor.accept(0.0);
288    m_rearRightMotor.accept(0.0);
289
290    feed();
291  }
292
293  @Override
294  public String getDescription() {
295    return "MecanumDrive";
296  }
297
298  @Override
299  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
300    table.log("Front Left Motor Velocity", m_frontLeftOutput);
301    table.log("Front Right Motor Velocity", m_frontRightOutput);
302    table.log("Rear Left Motor Velocity", m_rearLeftOutput);
303    table.log("Rear Right Motor Velocity", m_rearRightOutput);
304  }
305
306  @Override
307  public String getTelemetryType() {
308    return "MecanumDrive";
309  }
310}
